note: Generated by tools/boss_data.py build from data/boss/boss_abilities.csv; do not edit.

doc.ability: a = ms after pull before the first cast (0 = no timer); b..c = repeat window ms (0/0 = one-shot); castMs 0 = unknown
doc.phase: rules are checked in order, first match wins; hp rules latch; start always matches and is last

14517.name: High Priestess Jeklik
notes: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.

14599.name: High Priest Thekal
notes: A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.

14515.name: High Priestess Arlokk
notes: Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.

11382.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
notes: Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.

11380.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
notes: Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.

14834.name: Hakkar
notes: Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.

10184.name: Onyxia
notes: Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.

15263.name: The Prophet Skeram
notes: Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.

15516.name: Battleguard Sartura
notes: The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.

15510.name: Fankriss the Unyielding
notes: Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.

15276.name: Emperor Vek'lor
notes: Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.

15589.name: Eye of C'Thun
notes: The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.

15727.name: C'Thun
notes: Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.

12118.name: Lucifron
notes: The first casts and the repeats are Seconds(10), Seconds(20), Seconds(6), Seconds(20), Seconds(15) and Seconds(6), which are not millisecond literals; the timer columns are 0.

11982.name: Magmadar
notes: Lava Bomb 19411 and 20474 only spawn game object 177704 through dummy spells 20494/20495; the patch is a game object, not a spell.

12057.name: Garr
notes: The Firesworn cast Immolate 15733, Thrash 8876 and Separation Anxiety 23492 themselves; on death they explode for 19497, or 20483 when Garr's 20482 forces the explosion.

12056.name: Baron Geddon
notes: Inferno roots him and ticks 19698 every second for nine ticks, 500 damage rising to 2500; below 5 percent Armageddon stops the fight AI.

11988.name: Golemagg the Incinerator
notes: Pyroblast's repeat is (3 + rand() % 4) seconds, not a literal; the Core Ragers cannot be killed while Golemagg lives and cast Mangle 19820 and Thrash 3391 themselves.

12018.name: Majordomo Executus
notes: One shared 30 s timer casts Magic Reflection 20619 or Damage Reflection 21075 at random (`rand() % 2`); the teleport's first window is 10000 + rand() % 20000 and its repeat 20000 + rand() % 10000; the Ragnaros event spells 19774 / 20568 / 19773 are gossip-event casts.

11502.name: Ragnaros
notes: Submerge starts 3*MINUTE after the pull and lasts 1.5*MINUTE; Lava Bursts are game objects 178088 and the Sons are summoned without a spell; Lava Shield 21857 comes from creature_template_addon; Intense Heat 21155 is cast by the Flame of Ragnaros trigger.

65020.name: Basalthar
notes: Its script has no cast; creature_spells 165020 lists Molten Bulwark 47375 every 30 s, Wide Backhand 47373 every 14 s and Crushing Slam 47374 every 16 s (seconds in that table, so the timer columns are 0). The twins share damage and healing and die together.

52145.name: Incindis
notes: Fire Nova 42037 is cast 1 s after each Quaking Stomp, not on a pull timer; the eggs hatch through their own AI (42042/42044) and Quaking Stomp is capped to one target by the spell script.

57642.name: Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan
notes: Rune of Detonation and Rune of Combustion alternate on one shared 20 s timer, Detonation first (boss_thane.cpp:86, 205-223); Rune of Power 52724/52729 is recast at 75, 50 and 25 percent and its zones are refreshed every 2 s for 7 s; the image casts Arcane Rupture and Arcane Barrage itself.
